# Pick Your AI contributor leaderboard

Make everyone's work visible through public, evidence-backed contributor portfolios and independent leaderboards across the [Pick-Your-AI organization](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI).

This repository contains the complete delivery baseline: **20 epics, 112 work packages, 474 checklist tasks, 227 delivery dependencies and 98 metric definitions**, plus local runtime scaffolding, versioned contracts and ingestion primitives. The public live service remains planned work. Merged code and passing synthetic tests do not establish production source coverage or release acceptance.

- [Delivery Project](https://github.com/orgs/Pick-Your-AI/projects/6) · [Program issue](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-leaderboard/issues/1)

- [Project configuration and dependency readback](docs/project-configuration-readback-20261018.md)
- [Release and operations plan](docs/OPERATIONS_PLAN.md)

The proposed product name is **PickYour.AI Credits**, with the tagline **Contributions, with evidence.** Recognition covers PRs, code and deletions, review, issues, triage, planning, research, documentation, design, accessibility, testing, maintenance and community work. There is no universal contributor score. Every board exposes its unit, period, source coverage and counting policy; observed activity, accepted outcomes and reviewed recognition remain distinct.

## Start contributing

Choose an issue from the Project, review its prerequisites and agree ownership before moving it to Ready. GitHub Assignees are authoritative. Work starts unassigned in Backlog; no dates, estimates or owners are invented. Use native sub-issues for the program → epic → work-package hierarchy and checklists for tasks. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) before changing the plan or implementing a package.

## Validate the planning baseline

Python 3.12 or newer is sufficient; there are no third-party dependencies for these checks.

```bash
python scripts/validate_plan.py
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
python scripts/render_docs.py --check
```

These checks cover planning integrity, mappings, dependency cycles, local links and generated documentation. They do not prove upstream API completeness, metric correctness in production, an accessible implementation, deployment or source accuracy. The corresponding issues retain those acceptance gates.

## Repository boundaries

The [research repository](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research) owns research decisions and its frozen builder v1 contracts. The [website repository](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-website) owns the web builder; the [Android](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-android) and [Apple](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-apple) repositories own their native applications. The [organization repository](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/.github) owns shared guidance. This repository owns contributor-recognition contracts, the local runtime and public-service delivery. The [dated organization inventory](docs/organization-boundaries.md) records stable identifiers and existing work. Live owners, source issues and native relationships remain authoritative.

The structured plan lives in [planning/](planning/README.md). See [local runtime setup](docs/runtime-foundation.md) for Node.js 24 startup, database migrations and explicitly synthetic fixtures, and [ingestion operations](docs/INGESTION.md) for the separate collector primitives. Public hosting and the proposed contributor subdomain require their own approved decisions and operational proof.
